scientific.integrity: The closest primary papers were inspected in public full text. Object, projection-length alias, exact-constant, decimal, and owned-record overlap searches were performed. The proof is analytic; bundled quadrature is only a regression check. Primary MSC 52A40 is the verified convex-geometric mean-width classification used in current mean-width literature.
limitations: Only the second directional-width moment of the unit-edge regular icosahedron is evaluated.
The full width distribution and higher moments are not claimed.
An unindexed classical calculation remains a residual originality risk.

title: Mean square width of the regular icosahedron
